paragraphs.text: Loot is a solitary being, a young beast of an unknown species and time that was discovered in stasis by the planeswalker Jace Beleren within Maag Taranau on Thunder Junction . As far as anyone knows, he is the only creature of his kind. His relationship to the Fomori and the Coin Empire has been hinted at, but remains unclear.

Loot's body is covered in fuzzy orange fur, and a single tuft of cream hair sits at the top of his head, wedged between two dark horns and a pair of pointed ears. He has large green eyes and a long tail that is hollow at the tip. Inside, a blue orb glows when he uses his powers. He has a very wide mouth full of small white teeth.

Loot has an uncanny ability to locate and navigate the Omenpaths , and has a map of the Multiverse inside his seemingly infinite mind. He knows the endpoint of every Omenpath and can see planes coming to life and also returning to darkness. This power does not seem to be the limit of his abilities. As he grows, he may prove not only able to uncover Omenpaths but to manifest them himself. Jace Beleren perceives Loot's mind as a vast interior that is as solid as steel, rather than the delicate, crystalline structure he perceives in others. He took a copy of the map from Loot's mind, but was unable to contain it himself, resorting to storing it across the minds of Theorix cadets.

Despite being hundreds or thousands of years old, Loot has the mindset of a young child. Curious, bright, and gregarious, Loot is eager to learn and quick to trust. He speaks in chirps and trills, but a rudimentary form of telepathy allows other beings to understand him. He is learning to read and write.
At some point, Loot was sealed in suspended animation inside Maag Taranau .

Around 4554 AR , during the time Jace Beleren was part of the Infinite Consortium , Tezzeret sent him to the then-unsettled plane of Thunder Junction to investigate Maag Taranau, to find something Nicol Bolas was afraid of. Jace detected a slumbering, childlike mind deep within the vault, but could not get in. After relaying this to Tezzeret, they never discussed the vault again.

Seven years later, months after the War of the Spark , Jace asked Tamiyo about the vault. She opened a scroll and told him about the strange creature inside the vault, including his gender and presumably his capabilities.

At the top of the innermost platform within Maag Taranau was a pod-like structure encased in glass. Metal stretched around the glowing sphere, marked with an ancient script and surrounded by threads of amber magic. Behind it was a mural of an enormous horned creature, towering over the platform like a guardian. When the planeswalker Oko approached the pod, he noticed a shape moving behind the glass, too obscured by a cloudy haze to make out properly.

Jace Beleren, disguised as Ashiok , revealed that he had been looking for the creature inside, Loot. He pressed both hands to the glass, and the pod shattered. Loot rested on what was left of the altar. After that, Jace and his collaborator Vraska disappeared with Loot.

Jace and Vraska cared for Loot, but they also needed his abilities for a plan they had devised together. With his mental map, they plotted a course across the Multiverse and left Thunder Junction with Loot in tow. One of their stops along the way was Bloomburrow .

Unfortunately, along the way, Loot wandered into a moth-covered door. Jace and Vraska followed him to Duskmourn where they quickly became separated. Jace came across the planeswalker Kaito Shizuki , whom the House had also separated from his friends. Jace and Kaito journeyed through the house together for a short time before Jace caught sight of Vraska shielding Loot from a razorkin . Although Jace went after his family, the demon Valgavoth captured Loot. Loot was forcibly conscripted onto the Speed Demons to use as a navigation aide in the 2nd Ghirapur Grand Prix . The team's captain, Winter , caged Loot on top of his vehicle, the Last Ride .

Before the beginning of the race, Chandra Nalaar of the Cloudspire Racing Team noticed Loot's mistreatment, immediately taking a dislike to his captor, Winter. This feeling was strengthened while observing Loot's suffering during the second leg of the race. During the third leg of the race on Muraganda , Winter lost hold of Loot when the little creature was captured by Saurid raiders. While they were waiting to be sacrificed, he befriended the goblin Daretti . Shortly after, they were rescued by Chandra and Pia Nalaar , who had witnessed Loot's capture at the hands of the saurids. Daretti quickly patched together his car, and Chandra drove it away from the village. The four barely managed to escape through an Omenpath to Amonkhet located by Loot, but they emerged some distance from the ground, and the car was seriously damaged in the landing. However, in a matter of hours, Daretti and Pia patched it up effectively enough that it was capable of finishing the race.

When the racers returned to Avishkar via an Omenpath located by Loot, they were confronted by Jace Beleren , who demanded the return of his child. He mind-controlled several racers while a dragonstorm formed, causing chaos in the city. Though they attempted to fight back, Jace rendered them unconscious, taking Loot back. The two left with Vraska, traveling to Tarkir .

While they rested on Tarkir, Vraska noted that Loot kept trying to hide from the mind mage and tried to dissuade Jace from keeping the creature in a stasis. While in the coma, Loot was kicking around like he was trying to squirm away from Jace's control.

With the help of Loot's mind map, Jace and Vraska traveled with him through an ancient Omenpath to the Meditation Plane . Here, Jace cast his spell to recreate the Multiverse . As it failed, it revealed a void that poured toward them, unmaking reality — Jace included. The distressed Loot was picked up by Narset right before the survivors escaped. Back on Tarkir, he was returned to the grieving Vraska, and they left together, making their way to Vryn.

On Vryn, Vraska and Jace's mother Ranna acted as parental figures for Loot, giving him a basic education. When Vraska learned of the Echoverse that Jace had created after the disaster in the Meditation Realm, she used Loot's talents to map a way there from Vryn, but did not bring him along, as she did not want him to see what Jace had become. Loot presumably attended Jace's funeral on Vryn in the aftermath of the Echoverse's downfall. He continued to live in the Beleren household and was present when Tam arrived at the house seeking Vraska's help.

In the Echoverse, Loot was a feral beast horror . Still trapped in Maag Taranau, he was awakened by the knowledge that something was wrong with the Multiverse. A nightmarish miasma hovered around him, coiling around the fabric of reality. He contained the power to create vortices and obliterate those who crossed his path. Claw marks scarred the metal vault walls, betraying his eagerness to escape. Loot was just one of the dangers the Theorist wanted to keep hidden and secure in the vault.

Loot's name is meant to literally be reflective of the word "loot," in the sense of "valuables seized by force." This is possible to infer from the fact that it has been translated to equivalent words in other languages, such as "Rapine" in French. His name and character may be inspired by Lugh , a figure in Irish mythology who is half Fomori and half Tuatha Dé Danann , a type of deity.
